en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Al Mukhtar Bin Muhammad Bin Al Mukhtar Al Hamdany and Muhammad Bin Al Hassan, from Abdullah Bin Al Hassan Al Alawy, altogether from Al Fatah Bin Yazeed Al Jurjany, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘And He<sup>azwj</sup> is Aware of the subtleties, the Aware, the Hearing, the Seeing, the One, the First, the Solid (not hollow), not begetting and not being begotten and there not being anyone a match for Him<sup>azwj</sup>. Had He<sup>azwj</sup> been just as the resemblers are saying, the Creator would not be recognised from the Created, nor the Builder from the Built. But He<sup>azwj</sup> is the Builder. There is (certainly) a difference between the One<sup>azwj</sup> Who Shapes it, and Images it, and Builds it, when it was so that nothing resembles Him<sup>azwj</sup>, nor does He<sup>azwj</sup> resemble anything’.

I said, ‘Certainly, may I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! But, you<sup>asws</sup> said, ‘The First, the Solid (not hollow)’, and you<sup>asws</sup> said, ‘Nothing resembles Him<sup>azwj</sup>’; and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is the One, and the human being is one. Isn’t there a resemblance of the oneness?’

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Fatah! You (have spoken an) impossibility, may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Affirm you! But rather, the resemblance is in the meaning. So, as for regarding the Names, so these are One, and they Indicate upon the Named, and that is because the human being, if he is said to be one, so he knows that he is one individual, and is not with two, and the human being himself is not with one, because his body parts are different, and his colours are difference, and the one whose colours are difference is without oneness, and he is a fragment of fragmentary bits. He isn’t with the equal-ness. His blood is other than his flesh, and his flesh is other than his blood, his nerves are other than his veins, and his hair is other than his skin, and his blackness is other than his whiteness. And similar to that are the entirety of the creatures.

So the human being is one in the name and is not one in the meaning; and Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Majestic is His<sup>azwj</sup> Majesty, He<sup>azwj</sup> is One, not being one of theirs, neither there being any differentials in Him<sup>azwj</sup>, nor discrepancies, nor an increase, nor a decrease. But, as for the human being, the Created, the Made, the Composed from different parts, and of various body parts, apart from that he is with the gathering of things as one’.

I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! You have relieved me, may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Relieve you<sup>asws</sup>! So, your<sup>asws</sup> words, ‘Aware of the subtleties, the Informed’, interpret it for me just as you<sup>asws</sup> interpreted the ‘One’, for I know that His<sup>azwj</sup> being Aware of the subtleties is difference from the awareness of His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures, apart from that I would love it if you<sup>asws</sup> could explain that for me’.

So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Fatah! But rather, we<sup>asws</sup> say: ‘The Aware of subtleties’, is for the subtleties of His<sup>azwj</sup> creation, and due to His<sup>azwj</sup> Knowledge of the subtle things. Or, do you not see, may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Harmonise you and Affirm you, to the impacts of His<sup>azwj</sup> Making, regarding the vegetation, the delicate and non-delicate, and from the delicate creatures, and from the small beasts, and from the mosquito, and the bird, and what is smaller than these what is almost not clear to the eyes, and is almost not clear due to its smallness, the male from the female, and the new born from the old.

So when we see that smallness in His<sup>azwj</sup> Awareness of the subtleties, and their desire for the reproduction, and the fleeing from the death, and the gathering to what is correct for it, and what is in the tossing of the seas, and what is in the bark of the trees, and in the wilderness and the wastelands, and their understanding each other, their speaking (communicating) and what their children understand by it from them, and their transferring the meal to them. 
Then the synthesis of their colours, red along with the yellow, and white along with red, and it is what the eyes can almost not clarify it due to the variance of its creation. Neither have our eyes seen it, nor have our hands touched it. We know that the Creator of these creatures is Aware of the subtleties, the Kind with the creatures what we<sup>asws</sup> specified, without (Using a) process, nor a tool, nor a machine; and that every maker of a thing, so (he makes it) from a thing, and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is the Creator, the Aware of the subtleties, the Majestic Creates and Makes, not from anything’.
en.sarwar: Some additions concerning the different connotations of names (and attributes) used both for Allah, the Creator and the created.
